Advantages: high performance, type-safe (especially TS), self-parameterization against injection, portability between databases, migration/transaction integration. Disadvantages: leaky abstraction (still have to understand SQL to avoid N+1), difficult to optimize complex queries, overhead, "magic" difficult to debug.
